form_label: Annual IT Return for Individuals Classified as MICRO or SMALL Taxpayers
source_head_note: Pinned remote commit read with git show (GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1). Local checkout 301f9a0f is stale and was not used. buwiz-oss 0f34106 holds a byte-identical copy of this file.
basis: verify.md section 4 (authoritative crosswalk) and sections 2-3 (typed aliases, locks). Every key, path and lock was re-read from the pinned file by gen_crosswalk.py, which fails on any mismatch.

books_policy_values.fill_mvp: Books may send this key in Slice A/B (MVP).
books_policy_values.fill_p6: Books may send this key only after P6 (payroll, 1601-C).
books_policy_values.fill_p7: Books may send this key only after P7 (1701-MS).
books_policy_values.forms_computes: Forms computes it. Books neither computes nor compares it (ADR-0007; replaces cross_check).
books_policy_values.never_fill: Books never sends this key (user, profile, prior filing, evidence or human entry).
books_policy_values.never_touch: App-written, derived, page-2 mirror or BIR online credential; Books never sends it.

key_semantics.key: Exact official key as spelled in the pinned schema (bindings/boxes). It may be refused by the fill tool.
key_semantics.fill_key: Exact string Books may put in fill_args. The official key when the fill tool accepts it, the typed alias when only that is accepted, otherwise null.
key_semantics.typed_alias: Typed name verified in code (verify.md s3-s4). Not an official box key.
key_semantics.lock: Schema lock flag (identity, profile, election) or null.
key_semantics.scope: taxpayer | spouse | row:N (schedule row, printed row number) | none.
key_semantics.sheet_id: Workbook field-tab ID (spreadsheet label). It is not an API key. See sheet_id_basis for how it was assigned.

checks_performed: Pinned file sha256 equals the full digest recorded in this file (buwiz-oss copy also equal).
Every binding key and every unmapped key is a box key; no duplicate box keys.
Every entry key is a pinned box key; every draft_path or option set path is copied from the pinned file.
Every member of a radio or checkbox group is listed under its parent, not dropped.
No amount is stored as a float; money is decimal text in Books (see the rules files).
notes: No lock on item 12 (txtTaxpayerNo12 group, c = eight_percent), item 17 (txtTaxpayerNo17, a = itemized, b = OSD) or taxCodeDropdown II015-II017. Nothing compares them with the profile election (verify.md s1 #3, s2 #10; blocker B7). Books never fills them.
Key txtTaxableCompensationIncomeNo7a is a computed display box for IV.7 (net sales), not compensation. It has no binding (verify.md s2 #15, REFUTED as 'bound').
Attachments box label reads 'Page 1 Item 33 Number Of Attachments' (txtPg1I33NumberOfAttachments, unmapped constant). The workbook ID is II.35 (correction 32 in research/spreadsheet-corrections.md).
No key exists for II.34 (TIN of authorized representative) (verify.md s2 #14). authorizeRepresentative binds the representative name.
Spouse (B-side) keys are refused in MVP (phase P7). The spouse dropdown binds II011 (compensation); the taxpayer dropdown does not.
Items IV.18A and IV.4: the ATP and ASP boxes are mapped to IV.18A by the BTP/BSP pattern (UNCONFIRMED). No pinned box is mapped to IV.4.
Schedule 4.10A, 4.13A/B, 4.20A/B and 5 No. 9 are runtime-indexed row families with no row template in the pin. They are not fillable.
Forms rounding for 1701-MS is not in this crosswalk; the printed 'whole peso' rule is UNCONFIRMED (verify.md s2 #83).

ADR-0007 (2026-10-29): books_policy cross_check became forms_computes (Books neither computes nor compares tax boxes). ATC selection keys, and inputs that need a tax classification, threshold or deductibility judgement, became never_fill (source forms or user_input). rule_ids now resolve to data/rules/*.rules.json mappings or not_mapped pointers (rule set r2).
